transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.
The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
The system shall automatically notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
